contentWithoutOnlyChangedCode.prompt: Find the surface area of these solids. Round to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Parallelogram prism with visible front, top and left faces; front opposite sides carry matching parallel marks. A dotted perpendicular height meets the base at a right angle.
spec.mathematics: Front base 40 cm, side 27 cm, perpendicular height 22 cm; prism length 15 cm.

inlines.text: Area of left and right sides

answer.worked:
Front and back: $2(40\times22)=1760\text{ cm}^2$.

Top and base: $2(40\times15)=1200\text{ cm}^2$.

Left and right sides: $2(27\times15)=810\text{ cm}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=1760+1200+810\\SA&=3770\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right-trapezoidal prism with front, top and slanted right face visible. Both left front corners have right-angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Parallel edges 110 mm and 150 mm; height 75 mm; slanted side 85 mm; prism length 122 mm. Measurements retained as supplied.

inlines.text: Area of the front and back faces (trapezia)

answer.worked:
Top: $110\times122=13\,420\text{ mm}^2$.

Base: $150\times122=18\,300\text{ mm}^2$.

LHS face: $75\times122=9150\text{ mm}^2$.

Slanted face: $85\times122=10\,370\text{ mm}^2$.

Front and back: $2\times\frac12(110+150)\times75=19\,500\text{ mm}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=13\,420+18\,300+9150+10\,370+19\,500\\SA&=70\,740\text{ mm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rhombic prism with dotted short diagonal, external long-diagonal dimension and matching ticks on all four front sides.
spec.mathematics: Rhombus diagonals 66 cm and 112 cm, side 65 cm; prism length 19 cm.

answer.worked:
Front and rear rhombi: $2\times\frac12\times66\times112=7392\text{ cm}^2$.

Four rectangular sides: $4\times65\times19=4940\text{ cm}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=7392+4940\\SA&=12\,332\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
